data.name: 17' Boston Whaler
data.headline: 90hp • Max 5 people or 950lbs
data.description:
There’s nothing like a classic. The 170 Montauk embodies the timeless look of Boston Whaler’s past, with simple lines, low-maintenance construction and pristine finish, while embracing new and modern craftsmanship like quiet-running, fuel-efficient standard 90-hp FourStroke outboard power.

Sport fishermen and pleasure cruisers alike will enjoy the 170 Montauk’s modified-V hull, which ensures quick planing and a smooth, dry ride.

It's no coincidence you see Boston Whaler hanging off the back of luxury motor yachts in many exotic ports. The 170 Montauk is “the” boat in their line-up that made whaler such an iconic brand in boating. Equally, well suited to summer picnic cruising or fishing near shore for halibut or rockfish, the 170 Montauk does it all superbly. No other 17’ boat is as seaworthy or comfortable.

Have your favorite summer playlist ready to use with the onboard Bluetooth sound system.

If you would like to reserve more than one boat at a time, please give us a call.

data.cancellation_notes:
##We understand that plans can change. Please review our cancellation policy carefully before booking.

##Deposits

- A 50% non-refundable deposit is required at the time of booking to secure your reservation.


##Standard Cancellation Periods

Cancellations must be made prior to the scheduled start time and are subject to the following notice requirements:


##1. Holiday & Holiday Weekends

- 7 days notice required for all rentals, regardless of duration or boat type.

-  Includes federal holidays and associated weekends.

##2. Rentals of 3 Hours or More

- 7 days notice required.

##3. Rentals of 2.5 Hours or Less

- 24 hours notice required.

##4. Multiple Boat Rentals (Any Duration)

- 14 days notice required.

##Missed or Late Cancellations

- Cancellations outside of the required notice period or no-shows will be charged 50% of the rental price.
data.disclaimers:
- A $700 damage deposit is required on the day of rental. Visa or MasterCard only, NO CASH, NO DEBIT CARD, NO AMEX accepted for damage deposit.
- A 3-hour minimum rental is required after 12pm on weekends from May 1–October 31.
- We reserve the right to increase the minimum rental period during busy times (most holidays, weekends, and busy weekdays) as well as those times when we are short-staffed.
- A 50%  deposit is required at the time of reservation on rentals of 3 or more hours.
- A 7-day notice is required for any changes or cancellation to the reservation of 3 or more hours, or you will forfeit your 50% rental deposit.
- A 24-hour notice is required for any changes or cancellation to the reservation of less than 3 hours. If 24-hour notice is not given to reservations of less than 3 hours, you will be charged 50% of the rental price.
